name: io.github.trungthanh-tran/cadtroly
title: cadtroly AutoCAD MCP
description: Vietnamese AutoCAD MCP for PDF/DWG conversion, drafting, standards and takeoffs.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOCAD_MCP_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend selection: auto (default), com (live AutoCAD, Windows) or ezdxf (headless DXF).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated absolute paths the server may read and write. Empty means no allowlist is enforced at all - traversal and system-directory checks still run, but nothing scopes the filesystem. Set this.

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Exposed tool profile: full (default) or lean.

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_PACKS
environmentVariables.description: Vertical packs to advertise: all (default) or a comma list of core, pid, settings, mech, arch, plant; core is always on.

environmentVariables.name: DISCOVERY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool discovery: off (default) advertises the full catalog; search replaces it with search_tools plus a call_tool proxy.
